Custom user-agent string is applied for single domain crawl

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from crawlberg import crawl, create_engine, CrawlConfig

async def main() -> None:
    engine_config = CrawlConfig(
        max_depth=0,
        stay_on_domain=True,
        user_agents=["Mozilla/5.0 TestBot/1.0 (+http://example.com/bot)"],
    )
    engine = create_engine(engine_config)
    url = "https://example.com"
    result = await crawl(engine, url)
    print(result)

asyncio.run(main())
```
